rich_narrative.summary: Transparent Hands USA provides free surgical care, medical treatments, and mobile health camps to impoverished patients across Pakistan. Founded in 2014, the organization coordinates direct direct-care services through partner medical facilities <cite id="7">and conducts large-scale medical camps</cite>. In FY2024, the charity reported <cite id="3">$606,605 in total revenue</cite>, maintaining a steady 3-year revenue growth rate of 3.9%. The organization directs <cite id="1">72.0% of its budget toward program expenses</cite>, which sits below the 75% industry standard and the 87.4% median for global health peer organizations. Transparent Hands holds a <cite id="1">Charity Navigator score of 89.8/100</cite> and has earned a Platinum Transparency Seal from Candid.
